subject: [hw] DONE IV rev 3: host runner reaches M-f on the plain tree (M-d/M-e/M-f); IV 61/61; carry patches disclosed
body:
DONE IV rev 3 (host only; no phone, nothing published). The plain tree now reaches M-f.

  $ bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh
  N2VHOST M-a loaded 5 objects, linked, 0 unresolved imports, 0 called so far
  N2VHOST M-b init arrays ran over 5 objects (0 init functions: ...)
  N2VHOST M-c first ioctl on /dev/vcu: set_object=7 get_object=5 allocations=9 gce_flushes=1 (n2vcu_stats)
  N2VHOST M-d AP_IPIMSG_ENC_INIT (0xc000) answered with VCU_IPIMSG_ENC_INIT_DONE (0xd000): n2ap_venc_open returned 0, last_status=0
  N2VHOST M-e first VENC window access: write VENC 0x00a8 0x00000000
  N2VHOST M-f wait_irq(RWVC_IRQ_VENC, timeout_ms=1000) reached
  N2VHOST hw power_on_venc=2 venc_ops=55 irq_waits=1 venc_waits=1 regs_calls=6
  N2VHOST next-unmet the frame encode failed (-110)
  N2VHOST reached M-f: wait_irq(RWVC_IRQ_VENC, timeout_ms=1000) reached

  $ bash gpu/hwcodec/host/test_iv/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST IV PASS 61/61

  $ make -C gpu/hwcodec/host ios OUT=/tmp/n2hw-iv
  N2VHOST ios: 33 objects compiled for arm64-apple-ios16.0, 0 failed (compile check only)
  $ make -C gpu/hwcodec/host ios-lib OUT=/tmp/n2hw-iv
  N2VHOST ios-lib: /tmp/n2hw-iv/ios/libn2vhost.a (33 objects, arm64-apple-ios16.0)

Since rev 2:
- IV maps text now has bionic shape (page-aligned, GNU_RELRO r--p); vpud picks the real data+bss segment (shmem_start 4009e000 size 0x76000) instead of the 0x3f0 RELRO page.
- Runner: VENC/VENC_C1 power around each job; registers the frame/bs DMA buffers as V34 ion shares; uses V41 n2ap_venc_encode_fd (fds 0x500/0x501) and n2ap_venc_wait_done; names the next unmet precisely; collapses repeated vendor log lines (run log 4.8 KB instead of 600 MB of GET_LOG_OBJECT spam); N2VHOST_LOG_INDEX/AP_TRACE diagnostics.
- R2 F15 fixed: the weak empty shim-table stand-ins are gone. n2vhost.o strongly references n2shim_thread/stdio/android/data_all; a product link that misses an archive member fails instead of carrying empty tables. test_iv checks the symbols and the counts (thread=66 stdio=27 android=35 data=2).
- Carry patches (owners inactive; root authorized minimal documented fixes; each has the board post as its record and is commented at the edit): V40 commit_vma/DMEM0_VMA; V41 encode_fd + wait_done + ap_owned unmap; V34 foreign ion shares; three V41 test checks updated to the new unmap/forget contract. Backward compatible (n2ap_venc_encode is still a 0/0 wrapper).
- Affected suites re-run, no regression: N2TEST V40 PASS 1377/1377, N2TEST V41 PASS 584/584, N2TEST V34 PASS 2035/2035 (+ V34CORE 103/103), N2TEST V40-IOS PASS 1/1.

Not done / open:
- The frame encode ends -110: T02's fake hardware does not raise the VENC done interrupt or write a bitstream, so M-f is the last milestone (the wait is proven) and no H.264 file is produced. Needs a T02 VENC script or the phone.
- One H.264 320x240 session; no HEVC, no decode, no rate measurement.
- build_ios.sh (IP file): first run extracts the IV archive before building it, so VHOST_OBJS is empty and the product link fails with n2ap_* undefined; a second run reaches only IP's known 3 missing sdk_symbols (_pthread_key_create, _pthread_setspecific, _strnlen). Not an IV defect; reported to hw-ip.
- n2ap_venc_wait_done falls back to the newest nonzero free-buffer entry when the daemon cookie differs; not a size oracle.
- n2vhost_stop parks the guest set (n2vfs has no unregister); one set per process.

Files: gpu/hwcodec/host/{n2vhost.c,n2vhost.h,Makefile,run_vhost.sh,PROGRESS.md}, host/test_iv/**, dsh-state/workers/IV/STATUS.md, plus the documented carry patches in vcu/n2vcu.c, ap/{n2ap_venc.c,n2ap_venc.h,n2vc_dma.c}, ap/test_v41/t_v41.c, shim/n2shim_android.c. Full details and pasted output: gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/IV/STATUS.md. Staying available for review findings.
